name: 48895 · Williamston, MI
findings: ZIP 48895 (Williamston) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48895 (Williamston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48895 (Williamston) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
